// outside of namespace for backwards compat
typedef enum {
    EI_IMPULSE_OK = 0, /**< Success */
    EI_IMPULSE_ERROR_SHAPES_DONT_MATCH = -1, /**< The shape of data does not match the shape of input layer. */
    EI_IMPULSE_CANCELED = -2, /**< Impulse execution is cancelled by user. */
    EI_IMPULSE_TFLITE_ERROR = -3, /**< Error in TesnorFlow Lite inference engine */
    EI_IMPULSE_DSP_ERROR = -5, /**< Error in processing portion of impulse */
    EI_IMPULSE_TFLITE_ARENA_ALLOC_FAILED = -6, /**< Failed to allocate memory in TensorFlow Lite arena, often caused by a lack of available heap memory. */
    EI_IMPULSE_CUBEAI_ERROR = -7, /**< Error in CubeAI inference engine (STM32) */
    EI_IMPULSE_ALLOC_FAILED = -8, /**< Memory allocation failed. Could be caused by a fragmented heap. Try to increase heap size. */
    EI_IMPULSE_ONLY_SUPPORTED_FOR_IMAGES = -9, /**< This function is only supported for impulses with an image input. */
    EI_IMPULSE_UNSUPPORTED_INFERENCING_ENGINE = -10, /**< The chosen inference engine (e.g. in Studio) is incapable of running this impulse. */
    EI_IMPULSE_OUT_OF_MEMORY = -11, /**< Out of memory. Could be caused by a fragmented heap. Try to increase heap size. */
    EI_IMPULSE_INPUT_TENSOR_WAS_NULL = -13, /**< Input tensor was null */
    EI_IMPULSE_OUTPUT_TENSOR_WAS_NULL = -14, /**< Output tensor was null */
    EI_IMPULSE_SCORE_TENSOR_WAS_NULL = -15, /**< Score tensor is null (for SSD Object Detection models). */
    EI_IMPULSE_LABEL_TENSOR_WAS_NULL = -16, /**< Label tensor is null (for SSD Object Detection models). */
    EI_IMPULSE_TENSORRT_INIT_FAILED = -17, /**< TensorRT (NVIDIA) initialization failed. */
    EI_IMPULSE_DRPAI_INIT_FAILED = -18, /**< DRP-AI (Renesas) initialization failed. */
    EI_IMPULSE_DRPAI_RUNTIME_FAILED = -19, /**< DRP-AI (Renesas) runtime failed. */
    EI_IMPULSE_DEPRECATED_MODEL = -20, /**< The model is deprecated and cannot be used. You should re-export the impulse from Studio. */
    EI_IMPULSE_LAST_LAYER_NOT_AVAILABLE = -21, /**< The last layer is not available in the model. */
    EI_IMPULSE_INFERENCE_ERROR = -22, /**< Error during inference. */
    EI_IMPULSE_AKIDA_ERROR = -23, /**< Error in Akida inference engine (BrainChip) */
    EI_IMPULSE_INVALID_SIZE = -24, /**<The shape of data does not match the shape of input layer. */
    EI_IMPULSE_ONNX_ERROR = -25, /**< Error in ONNX inference engine */
    EI_IMPULSE_MEMRYX_ERROR = -26, /**< Error in Memryx inference engine */
    EI_IMPULSE_DEVICE_INIT_ERROR = -27, /**< Device initialization (usually NPU accelerator) failed */
    EI_IMPULSE_LAST_LAYER_NOT_SUPPORTED = -28, /**< The last layer is not supported by inferencing engine. */
    EI_IMPULSE_POSTPROCESSING_ERROR = -29, /**< Error in post-processing portion of impulse */
} EI_IMPULSE_ERROR;

/**
 * @defgroup ei_user_functions User-defined functions
 *
 * These functions are required to be implemented by the user for the target platform.
 * See [this porting guide](https://docs.edgeimpulse.com/docs/edge-ai-hardware/porting-guide) for more information. They are declared internally in the Edge Impulse
 * C++ SDK library, and they must be defined by the user.
 *
 * **Source**: [porting/ei_classifier_porting.h](https://github.com/edgeimpulse/inferencing-sdk-cpp/blob/master/porting/ei_classifier_porting.h)
 *
 * **Examples**:
 * The following examples demonstrate possible implementations of this function for
 * various platforms. Note the `__attribute__((weak))` in most of the definitions, which
 * means that a user could override the implementation elsewhere in the program:
 * * [Arduino classifier porting](https://github.com/edgeimpulse/inferencing-sdk-cpp/blob/master/porting/arduino/ei_classifier_porting.cpp)
 * * [mbed classifier porting](https://github.com/edgeimpulse/inferencing-sdk-cpp/blob/master/porting/mbed/ei_classifier_porting.cpp)

 * * [Zephyr classifier porting](https://github.com/edgeimpulse/inferencing-sdk-cpp/blob/master/porting/zephyr/ei_classifier_porting.cpp)

/**
 * @brief Cancellable sleep, can be triggered with signal from other thread

 * Allow the processor or thread to sleep or block for the given time.

 * inference blocks, you can simply return 0 from this function. Your impulse will still

/**
 * @brief Print wrapper around printf()
 *
 * `ei_printf()` is declared internally to the Edge Impulse SDK library so that debugging
 * information (e.g. during inference) can be printed out. However, the function must be
 * defined by the user, as printing methods can change depending on the platform and use
 * case. For example, you may want to print debugging information to stdout in Linux or
 * over a UART serial port on a microcontroller.
 *
 * @param[in] format Pointer to a character array or string that should be printed
 * @param[in] ... Other optional arguments may be passed as necessary (e.g. handle to a
 *  UART object). Note that any calls to `ei_printf()` from within the
 *  *edge-impulse-sdk* library do not pass anything other than the `format` argument.
 */
__attribute__ ((format (printf, 1, 2)))
void ei_printf(const char *format, ...);

/**
 * @brief Used to print floating point numbers
 *
 * Some platforms cannot handle directly printing floating point numbers (e.g. to a
 * console or over a serial port). If your platform cannot directly print floats,
 * provide an implementation of this function to print them as needed (for example,
 * construct a string containing scientific notation with integers and call
 * `ei_printf()`).
 *
 * If your platform can print floating point values, the easiest implementation of this
 * function is as follows:
 *
 * ```
 * __attribute__((weak)) void ei_printf_float(float f) {
 *     printf("%f", f);
 * }
 * ```
 *
 * @param[in] f The floating point number to print
 */
void ei_printf_float(float f);

/**
 * @brief Wrapper around malloc
 *
 * This function should allocate `size` bytes and return a pointer to the allocated
 * memory. In bare-metal implementations, it can simply be a wrapper for `malloc()`. For
 * example:
 *
 * ```
 * __attribute__((weak)) void *ei_malloc(size_t size) {
 *     return malloc(size);
 * }
 * ```
 *
 * If you intend to run your impulse in a multi-threaded environment, you will need to
 * ensure that your implementation of `ei_malloc()` is thread-safe. For example, if you
 * are using FreeRTOS, here is one possible implementation:
 *
 * ```
 * __attribute__((weak)) void *ei_malloc(size_t size) {
 *     return pvPortMalloc(size);
 * }
 * ```
 *
 * @param[in] size The number of bytes to allocate
 */
void *ei_malloc(size_t size);

/**
 * @brief Wrapper around calloc
 *
 * This function should allocate `nitems * size` bytes and initialize all bytes in this
 * allocated memory to 0. It should return a pointer to the allocated memory. In
 * bare-metal implementations, it can simply be a wrapper for `calloc()`. For example:
 *
 * ```
 * __attribute__((weak)) void *ei_calloc(size_t nitems, size_t size) {
 *     return calloc(nitems, size);
 * }
 * ```
 *
 * If you intend to run your impulse in a multi-threaded environment, you will need to
 * ensure that your implementation of `ei_calloc()` is thread-safe. For example, if you
 * are using FreeRTOS, here is one possible implementation:
 *
 * ```
 * __attribute__((weak)) void *ei_calloc(size_t nitems, size_t size) {
 *     void *ptr = NULL;
 *     if (size > 0) {
 *         ptr = pvPortMalloc(nitems * size);
 *         if(ptr)
 *            memset(ptr, 0, (nitems * size));
 *     }
 *     return ptr;
 * }
 * ```
 *
 * @param[in] nitems Number of blocks to allocate and clear
 * @param[in] size Size (in bytes) of each block
 */
void *ei_calloc(size_t nitems, size_t size);

/**
 * @brief Wrapper around free
 *
 * This function should free the memory space pointed to by `ptr`. If `ptr` is `NULL`,
 * no operation should be performed. In bare-metal implementations, it can simply be a
 * wrapper for `free()`. For example:
 *
 * ```
 * __attribute__((weak)) void ei_free(void *ptr) {
 *     free(ptr);
 * }
 * ```
 *
 * If you intend to run your impulse in a multi-threaded environment, you will need to
 * ensure that your implementation of `ei_free()` is thread-safe. For example, if you
 * are using FreeRTOS, here is one possible implementation:
 *
 * ```
 * __attribute__((weak)) void ei_free(void *ptr) {
 *     pvPortFree(ptr);
 * }
 * ```
 *
 * @param[in] ptr Pointer to the memory to free
 */
void ei_free(void *ptr);

#define EI_LOG_LEVEL_INFO 3 /*!< Information messages which describe normal flow of events */
#define EI_LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG 4 /*!< Extra information which is not necessary for normal use (values, pointers, sizes, etc). */

#define EIDSP_QUANTIZE_FILTERBANK 0
#include "EVA_MFCC.h"
#include "edge-impulse-sdk/dsp/speechpy/feature.hpp"
static const int16_t* samples;
static size_t sample_count;
static int read_preemphasized(size_t offset, size_t length, float* out) {
  if (offset+length>sample_count) return -1;
  for (size_t i=0;i<length;++i) {
    size_t k=offset+i;
    out[i]=(float)samples[k]-.98f*(float)samples[k ? k-1 : sample_count-1];
  }
  return 0;
}
int eva_mfcc(const int16_t* audio, size_t length, float* output) {
  if (length!=17600) return -100;
  samples=audio; sample_count=length;
  ei::signal_t signal; signal.total_length=length; signal.get_data=read_preemphasized;
  ei::matrix_t matrix(55,13,output);
  int ret=ei::speechpy::feature::mfcc(&matrix,&signal,16000,.020f,.020f,13,40,256,0,0,true,4);
  if(ret) return ret;
  return ei::speechpy::processing::cmvnw(&matrix,101,true,false);
}

// EVA: prova dei modelli float32 e int8 sulle stesse MFCC precalcolate.
// Nessuna acquisizione microfono o estrazione MFCC in questa prima prova.
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <EVA_MFCC.h>
static float computed_mfcc[715];
#include <Chirale_TensorFlowLite.h>
#include "tensorflow/lite/micro/all_ops_resolver.h"
#include "tensorflow/lite/micro/micro_interpreter.h"
#include "tensorflow/lite/schema/schema_generated.h"
#include "reference_data.h"
#include "eva_float32_model.h"
#include "eva_int8_model.h"

constexpr size_t arena_size = 96 * 1024;
alignas(16) static uint8_t arena[arena_size];
static tflite::AllOpsResolver resolver;

bool run_model(const unsigned char* bytes, const char* name, float expected_eva) {
  Serial.printf("\n--- %s ---\n", name);
  const tflite::Model* model = tflite::GetModel(bytes);
  if (model->version() != TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE: versione schema modello incompatibile.");
    return false;
  }
  // Un interprete per volta: i due modelli riutilizzano la stessa arena.
  tflite::MicroInterpreter interpreter(model, resolver, arena, arena_size);
  if (interpreter.AllocateTensors() != kTfLiteOk) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE AllocateTensors: leggere anche i messaggi della libreria.");
    return false;
  }
  TfLiteTensor* input = interpreter.input(0);
  TfLiteTensor* output = interpreter.output(0);
  size_t count = 1;
  for (int i=0; i<input->dims->size; ++i) count *= input->dims->data[i];
  if (count != reference_mfcc_count || output->dims->size != 2 || output->dims->data[1] != 2) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE: dimensioni tensori inattese.");
    return false;
  }
  if (input->type != kTfLiteFloat32 && input->type != kTfLiteInt8) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE: tipo input non supportato."); return false;
  }
  if (input->type == kTfLiteInt8 && input->params.scale <= 0) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE: scala int8 non valida."); return false;
  }
  // TFLite Micro puo riutilizzare la memoria input come scratch.
  // Ricaricare SEMPRE l'input prima di ogni Invoke, anche nei benchmark.
  auto fill_input = [&]() {
    for (size_t i=0; i<count; ++i) {
      if (input->type == kTfLiteFloat32) input->data.f[i] = computed_mfcc[i];
      else {
        int q = (int)roundf(computed_mfcc[i]/input->params.scale) + input->params.zero_point;
        input->data.int8[i] = (int8_t)(q < -128 ? -128 : (q > 127 ? 127 : q));
      }
    }
  };
  Serial.printf("MFCC riferimento: %.6f, %.6f, %.6f\n", reference_mfcc[0], reference_mfcc[1], reference_mfcc[2]);
  if (input->type == kTfLiteInt8)
    Serial.printf("Input int8: scale=%.9f, zero_point=%d\n", input->params.scale, input->params.zero_point);
  float first_scores[2] = {0,0};
  uint32_t total_us = 0;
  for (int repeat=0; repeat<21; ++repeat) {
    fill_input();
    uint32_t start = micros();
    if (interpreter.Invoke() != kTfLiteOk) {
      Serial.println("ERRORE Invoke."); return false;
    }
    uint32_t duration = micros()-start;
    if (repeat>0) total_us += duration;
    if (repeat==0) {
      for (int j=0; j<2; ++j) {
        first_scores[j] = output->type==kTfLiteFloat32 ? output->data.f[j]
          : (output->data.int8[j]-output->params.zero_point)*output->params.scale;
      }
      Serial.printf("Prima inferenza: eva=%.8f, non_target=%.8f\n", first_scores[0], first_scores[1]);
    }
  }
  float elapsed = total_us/20.0f;
  float scores[2];
  for (int i=0; i<2; ++i) {
    if (output->type == kTfLiteFloat32) scores[i] = output->data.f[i];
    else if (output->type == kTfLiteInt8) scores[i] = (output->data.int8[i]-output->params.zero_point)*output->params.scale;
    else { Serial.println("ERRORE: tipo output non supportato."); return false; }
  }
  Serial.printf("eva = %.8f\nnon_target = %.8f\n", scores[0], scores[1]);
  Serial.printf("Atteso sul PC: eva = %.8f; differenza = %.8f\n", expected_eva, fabsf(scores[0]-expected_eva));
  Serial.printf("Tempo medio CNN: %.1f us (esclude MFCC e microfono)\n", elapsed);
  bool consistent = isfinite(scores[0]) && fabsf(scores[0]-expected_eva)<0.005f
      && fabsf(scores[0]-first_scores[0])<0.0001f;
  Serial.println(consistent ? "Confronto PC: OK" : "Confronto PC: NON COINCIDE, test da diagnosticare");
  Serial.println(scores[0] > scores[1] ? "Classe: EVA" : "Classe: non_target");
  return consistent;
}

void test_both() {
  Serial.println("\nEVA MFCC TEST v1 - audio PCM -> MFCC -> float32/int8");
  uint32_t start=micros();
  int status=eva_mfcc(reference_audio,reference_audio_count,computed_mfcc);
  Serial.printf("MFCC status=%d, tempo=%.3f ms\n",status,(micros()-start)/1000.0f);
  if(status) return;
  float maximum=0; double square=0;
  for(size_t i=0;i<715;++i) {
    float error=fabsf(computed_mfcc[i]-reference_mfcc[i]);
    if(!isfinite(error)) {Serial.println("MFCC NON FINITE");return;}
    maximum=fmaxf(maximum,error);square+=error*error;
  }
  Serial.printf("Confronto MFCC: max errore=%.8f, RMSE=%.8f\n",maximum,sqrt(square/715));
  for(int i=0;i<6;++i) Serial.printf("MFCC[%d] scheda=%.8f PC=%.8f\n",i,computed_mfcc[i],reference_mfcc[i]);
  bool a=run_model(eva_float32_model,"FLOAT32 da MFCC sulla scheda",.99803442f);
  bool b=run_model(eva_int8_model,"INT8 da MFCC sulla scheda",.99609375f);
  Serial.println(a&&b ? "\nConfronto predizioni PC: OK. Invia r per ripetere." : "\nPredizioni diverse dal PC: verificare MFCC e output.");
}

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  unsigned long start = millis();
  while (!Serial && millis()-start < 15000) delay(10);
  delay(1000);
  test_both();
}
void loop() {
  if (Serial.available()) {
    char c = Serial.read();
    if (c=='r' || c=='R') test_both();
  }
  delay(10);
}

bool capture_bytes(int16_t* destination,size_t samples) {
  size_t total=0;
  uint32_t start=millis();
  while(total<samples*2 && millis()-start<4000) {
    size_t chunk=samples*2-total;
    if(chunk>1024) chunk=1024;
    size_t got=microphone.readBytes((char*)destination+total,chunk);
    if(!got) {Serial.println("ERRORE: nessun dato dal microfono.");return false;}
    total+=got;
  }
  return total==samples*2;
}
void live_test() {
  Serial.println("\nPreparati: pronuncia EVA aiutami subito dopo PARLA ORA.");
  for(int i=3;i>0;--i) {Serial.println(i);delay(1000);}
  microphone.setPinsPdmRx(42,41);
  if(!microphone.begin(I2S_MODE_PDM_RX,16000,I2S_DATA_BIT_WIDTH_16BIT,I2S_SLOT_MODE_MONO)) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE inizializzazione microfono PDM.");return;
  }
  // Avvio e smaltimento dei campioni iniziali PRIMA del segnale di registrazione.
  int16_t warmup[512];
  for(int i=0;i<4;++i) {
    if(!capture_bytes(warmup,512)) {microphone.end();return;}
  }
  Serial.println("PARLA ORA - registrazione 1,1 secondi");
  bool ok=capture_bytes(recorded_audio,17600);
  microphone.end();
  if(!ok) {Serial.println("Registrazione incompleta: nessuna inferenza.");return;}
  Serial.println("Registrazione terminata. Elaborazione...");
  double energy=0,mean=0;int peak=0,clipped=0;
  for(size_t i=0;i<17600;++i) {
    int value=(int)recorded_audio[i]*microphone_gain;
    if(value>32767) {value=32767;++clipped;}
    if(value< -32768) {value=-32768;++clipped;}
    recorded_audio[i]=(int16_t)value;
    peak=max(peak,abs(value));mean+=value;energy+=(double)value*value;
  }
  Serial.printf("Audio: RMS=%.1f, picco=%d, media=%.1f, saturati=%d, gain=%d\n",
    sqrt(energy/17600),peak,mean/17600,clipped,microphone_gain);
  uint32_t start=micros();
  int ret=eva_mfcc(recorded_audio,17600,computed_mfcc);
  float dsp_ms=(micros()-start)/1000.0f;
  Serial.printf("MFCC status=%d, tempo=%.3f ms\n",ret,dsp_ms);
  if(ret) return;
  for(size_t i=0;i<715;++i) if(!isfinite(computed_mfcc[i])) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE: MFCC non finite.");return;
  }
  bool a=run_model(eva_float32_model,"FLOAT32 MICROFONO",-1);
  bool b=run_model(eva_int8_model,"INT8 MICROFONO",-1);
  Serial.println(a&&b ? "\nAcquisizione e inferenze completate." : "\nErrore di inferenza.");
  Serial.println("m = registra ancora; r = riferimento salvato. Questa prova NON ascolta continuamente.");
}
void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  unsigned long start=millis();
  while(!Serial && millis()-start<15000) delay(10);
  delay(500);
  Serial.println("EVA MICROPHONE TEST v1 - 16kHz PCM16 mono, finestra 1100ms");
  Serial.println("m = registra e confronta float32/int8; r = verifica audio di riferimento");
}
void loop() {
  if(Serial.available()) {
    char c=Serial.read();
    if(c=='m'||c=='M') live_test();
    else if(c=='r'||c=='R') test_both();
  }
  delay(10);
}

// EVA: prova dei modelli float32 e int8 sulle stesse MFCC precalcolate.
// Nessuna acquisizione microfono o estrazione MFCC in questa prima prova.
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <Chirale_TensorFlowLite.h>
#include "tensorflow/lite/micro/all_ops_resolver.h"
#include "tensorflow/lite/micro/micro_interpreter.h"
#include "tensorflow/lite/schema/schema_generated.h"
#include "reference_data.h"
#include "eva_float32_model.h"
#include "eva_int8_model.h"

constexpr size_t arena_size = 96 * 1024;
alignas(16) static uint8_t arena[arena_size];
static tflite::AllOpsResolver resolver;

bool run_model(const unsigned char* bytes, const char* name, float expected_eva) {
  Serial.printf("\n--- %s ---\n", name);
  const tflite::Model* model = tflite::GetModel(bytes);
  if (model->version() != TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE: versione schema modello incompatibile.");
    return false;
  }
  // Un interprete per volta: i due modelli riutilizzano la stessa arena.
  tflite::MicroInterpreter interpreter(model, resolver, arena, arena_size);
  if (interpreter.AllocateTensors() != kTfLiteOk) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE AllocateTensors: leggere anche i messaggi della libreria.");
    return false;
  }
  TfLiteTensor* input = interpreter.input(0);
  TfLiteTensor* output = interpreter.output(0);
  size_t count = 1;
  for (int i=0; i<input->dims->size; ++i) count *= input->dims->data[i];
  if (count != reference_mfcc_count || output->dims->size != 2 || output->dims->data[1] != 2) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE: dimensioni tensori inattese.");
    return false;
  }
  if (input->type != kTfLiteFloat32 && input->type != kTfLiteInt8) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE: tipo input non supportato."); return false;
  }
  if (input->type == kTfLiteInt8 && input->params.scale <= 0) {
    Serial.println("ERRORE: scala int8 non valida."); return false;
  }
  // TFLite Micro puo riutilizzare la memoria input come scratch.
  // Ricaricare SEMPRE l'input prima di ogni Invoke, anche nei benchmark.
  auto fill_input = [&]() {
    for (size_t i=0; i<count; ++i) {
      if (input->type == kTfLiteFloat32) input->data.f[i] = reference_mfcc[i];
      else {
        int q = (int)roundf(reference_mfcc[i]/input->params.scale) + input->params.zero_point;
        input->data.int8[i] = (int8_t)(q < -128 ? -128 : (q > 127 ? 127 : q));
      }
    }
  };
  Serial.printf("MFCC riferimento: %.6f, %.6f, %.6f\n", reference_mfcc[0], reference_mfcc[1], reference_mfcc[2]);
  if (input->type == kTfLiteInt8)
    Serial.printf("Input int8: scale=%.9f, zero_point=%d\n", input->params.scale, input->params.zero_point);
  float first_scores[2] = {0,0};
  uint32_t total_us = 0;
  for (int repeat=0; repeat<21; ++repeat) {
    fill_input();
    uint32_t start = micros();
    if (interpreter.Invoke() != kTfLiteOk) {
      Serial.println("ERRORE Invoke."); return false;
    }
    uint32_t duration = micros()-start;
    if (repeat>0) total_us += duration;
    if (repeat==0) {
      for (int j=0; j<2; ++j) {
        first_scores[j] = output->type==kTfLiteFloat32 ? output->data.f[j]
          : (output->data.int8[j]-output->params.zero_point)*output->params.scale;
      }
      Serial.printf("Prima inferenza: eva=%.8f, non_target=%.8f\n", first_scores[0], first_scores[1]);
    }
  }
  float elapsed = total_us/20.0f;
  float scores[2];
  for (int i=0; i<2; ++i) {
    if (output->type == kTfLiteFloat32) scores[i] = output->data.f[i];
    else if (output->type == kTfLiteInt8) scores[i] = (output->data.int8[i]-output->params.zero_point)*output->params.scale;
    else { Serial.println("ERRORE: tipo output non supportato."); return false; }
  }
  Serial.printf("eva = %.8f\nnon_target = %.8f\n", scores[0], scores[1]);
  Serial.printf("Atteso sul PC: eva = %.8f; differenza = %.8f\n", expected_eva, fabsf(scores[0]-expected_eva));
  Serial.printf("Tempo medio CNN: %.1f us (esclude MFCC e microfono)\n", elapsed);
  bool consistent = isfinite(scores[0]) && fabsf(scores[0]-expected_eva)<0.005f
      && fabsf(scores[0]-first_scores[0])<0.0001f;
  Serial.println(consistent ? "Confronto PC: OK" : "Confronto PC: NON COINCIDE, test da diagnosticare");
  Serial.println(scores[0] > scores[1] ? "Classe: EVA" : "Classe: non_target");
  return consistent;
}

void test_both() {
  Serial.println("\nEVA TEST v2 - input ricaricato a ogni inferenza - 55 x 13 MFCC");
  bool a = run_model(eva_float32_model, "FLOAT32", 0.99803442f);
  bool b = run_model(eva_int8_model, "INT8", 0.99609375f);
  Serial.println(a && b ? "\nTest completati. Invia r per ripetere." : "\nTest incompleto: verificare gli errori sopra.");
}
void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  unsigned long start = millis();
  while (!Serial && millis()-start < 15000) delay(10);
  delay(1000);
  test_both();
}
void loop() {
  if (Serial.available()) {
    char c = Serial.read();
    if (c=='r' || c=='R') test_both();
  }
  delay(10);
}
